_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 9 (Tal: PRIORITISE). Frame.io NEEDS TO BE EDITED / KIDNESS TEST / CHRISTAIN HUY TEL ABJV. V1_MAIN. Shape (formats/kindness-test.md, his own cuts + MD Motivator): ASK -> THE YES -> IDENTITY (Christian / Jewish / almost the same) -> two pitas -> REVEAL -> REFUSAL held on his face -> PAY IT ON. Erez grammar: wide -> 4-frame snap -> tight hold; every in/out on the 30fps grid; grade off (bright phone + glasses footage, LESSONS 72). Cameras: 53xx = Meta POV 3:4 (Johnny's face), IMG_92xx = iPhone observer 9:16 (Tal as a character). iPhone beats carry the POV audio (push.audio) so the sound never changes character at an angle change; offsets measured by align-cameras.py (IMG_9236 = 5356 + 35.48s, score 0.58; IMG_9238 = 5370 - 4.60s, score 0.54). Captions come from hand-segmented, two-model-checked phrase files in cache/translate/<id>.json. PAY IT ON: the man on the street told Tal on camera he did not want it published (5377 22-34s, Hebrew, two models); Tal answered he was not publishing it. So his FACE IS NOT IN THIS CUT: approach from behind, then tight crops on the hands and the pitas only (crops simulated on source stills at 4 times per beat before rendering).
beats: ASK, iPhone: Tal at the counter - 'I'm really hungry and I just don't have any money' (POV audio)
POV: Johnny listening - 'I lost my wallet... a piece of bread' + THE YES: 'Why a piece of bread? I can make a pita with kebab, my friend'
iPhone: Tal - 'But I don't have any money' (speaker change = angle change)
THE DECISION: 'That's okay. If you need to eat, I'll feed you'
IDENTITY: 'We're Christians. We feed anyone that's in need' - the cross on his chest in frame
iPhone: Tal - 'You know, I'm Jewish, and in my religion we're also taught to help...' (ends before the operator's zoom at 63.3)
POV reaction under '...anyone in need' -> 'I know' + THE HEART: 'We're almost the same. It goes, love your neighbor as yourself (Hebrew), with you. It goes the same with us'
MAKING: pita in his hands - 'Whenever you need food, just come over, I got you'
TWO PITAS: he turns with both - 'That's for you my friend' / 'Why did you make me two?' + 'That's one for you, one for someone who needs it as well' - sets up the ending
REVEAL, iPhone: Tal - 'Actually, I want to be honest, and I do have money' (POV audio)

THE REFUSAL, one unbroken shot (15.7s): 500 shekels / No, my friend... No money involved / I'm very sure / It's from my heart / That's okay. Ends BEFORE 35.3-37.0, which measures as TAL feeding the line (his level -18 dB, his pitch 140 Hz)
THE LINE Tal asked for, Johnny's own clean take (37.6-39.07, his level and pitch): Just give it to someone who needs it - the bridge out of the shop
POV: the second pita carried into the market
POV: walking up to him, from behind (no face in these frames)
SECOND ANGLE (iPhone): Tal crouched, holding the pita out to him - FACE BLURRED
GLASSES, NORMAL FRAMING: the handover - Tal: This is for you, my brother (face BLURRED)
the pita goes into his arms - his voice and Tal's bon-appetit are under this: MUTED, room tone from the same shot (5377 40.32-42.12, no voiced frames)
iPhone: the two of them, the pita in his arms (face BLURRED; market ambience 5272)
GLASSES, NORMAL FRAMING: the cheers - the two pitas touch (face BLURRED). Starts AFTER Tal's bete'avon achi (35.38-35.92), which is out; the l'chaim stays muted (room tone 5377 43.2-44.4)
GLASSES, NORMAL FRAMING: he lifts the pita and takes a bite (40.4-40.9) - face BLURRED; muted, market ambience 5272
_capY: 0.62, not the 0.66 default: in the POV shots Johnny's face sits mid-frame and 0.66 put the caption over his mouth (seen on the first render). Every POV beat is now aimed so his face is in the top ~45% and the caption sits on his chest; in the Christians beat the cross stays visible below it.
_v2: V2 (coordinator, Tal rule LESSONS 78 for the man who said not to publish: remove his audio, blur his face). Cut identical to V1 (spec kept as edit.v1.json) except the two street beats are split so his voice is gone: (1) handover 5377 17.2333-17.7333 muted - faint voice at 17.25-17.53 at his pitch (163-180 Hz) - replaced by room tone from the same shot, 5377 57.4-57.9 (no voiced frames, -36..-41 dB); (2) toast 5377 36.3667-37.5 muted - the L'CHAIM at 36.43-36.88 cannot be attributed to Tal with confidence (pitch 145-160 rising to 267; his mouth is not visible enough on the frames) and there is a faint voiced frame at 37.35 - replaced by room tone from 5377 43.3-44.43 (no voiced frames, -34..-39 dB, same level as the gap at 35.95-36.40). Caption CHEERS dropped. Tal's own lines kept: THIS IS FOR YOU MY BROTHER (16.51-17.19, 98-142 Hz, one voice) and BON APPETIT BROTHER (35.38-35.92, 110-150 Hz, one voice). His face: never in frame (crops y>0.5 / from behind), so no blur.
_nozoom: Tal 2026-10-03: 'stop with all the zooms its weird' (LESSONS 80). Every beat constant framing z:[a,a]; the 4-frame ramp beats are deleted and their frames folded into the hold that followed; wide-then-tight on one take merged into one shot at z1.0 (the 3:4 POV and 9:16 iPhone both fill 9:16 at z1, and at z1 the caption at capY 0.62 sits on the chest, clear of the mouth). Only exception: the two street shots keep a STATIC z2.0 crop, because that crop is what keeps the man's face out (LESSONS 78). Slow motion and hard cuts unchanged; no in/out moved except where a ramp was folded (all on the 30fps grid).
_v4: V4 (Tal: the first is great, but towards the end, I told him to say a line, and then show me walking up to the homeless guy - just blur his face and add 2 angles and zoom). Beats 1-10 identical to V3. Ending rebuilt: refusal -> the coached line (Johnny's take 2) -> POV walk-up -> iPhone wide -> POV handover with ONE zoom -> iPhone two-shot -> pitas. Time only moves forward (5377 = IMG_9239 + 14.44s, by envelope correlation 0.27 AND by eye: Tal stands at 5377 73.5 / IMG_9239 59). The V3 slow-mo smile and the I'm Johnny beat are OUT: both happen after the line, and the line has to cut straight to the walk. build-edit writes ..._V4_NOBLUR.mp4 (his face is VISIBLE in it - scratch only, deleted after the blur); the deliverable is EK_CHRISTIAN_TELAVIV_V4.mp4, made by scripts/blur-face.py with blur-rules.json.
_v5: V5 (Tal on V4: no bon appetit; the glasses handover is good but too zoomed - normal framing, just blur his face; then the cheers; then him taking a bite). Beats 1-15 identical to V4. Ending: handover at z1 (no crop, no push) -> iPhone two-shot -> cheers at z1 -> the bite (5377 39.5-40.9, the first bite after the cheers; a second one is at 44.9-45.3 at the frame edge). No zoom anywhere. BON APPETIT caption and Tal's spoken line are out. His voice muted as before. build writes ..._V5_NOBLUR.mp4 (scratch, face visible, deleted after the blur); deliverable EK_CHRISTIAN_TELAVIV_V5.mp4 via blur-mask.py + blur-face.py --merge. Built with a private proxy-only copy of build-edit.mjs because the fast cut's HQ spans in cache/hq make the shared builder clamp and mis-graft this project.
